title: Ruscogenin Exerts Anxiolytic-Like Effect via Microglial NF-kappaB/MAPKs/NLRP3 Signaling Pathways in Mouse Model of Chronic Inflammatory Pain.
authors: Qi, Jing-Yu; Jin, Yu-Chen; Wang, Xin-Shang; Yang, Liu-Kun; Lu, Liang; Yue, Jiao; Yang, Fan; Liu, Yong-Sheng; Jiang, Yong-Li; Song, Da-Ke; Lv, Tao; Li, Xu-Bo; Zhang, Kun; Liu, Shui-Bing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分Ruscogenin通过TLR4介导的NF-kappaB/MAPKs/NLRP3信号通路缓解慢性炎性疼痛小鼠的焦虑样行为，属于小分子-蛋白信号通路药理学研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Long-term inflammation can cause chronic pain and trigger patients' anxiety by sensitizing the central nervous system. However, effective drugs with few side effects for treating chronic pain-induced anxiety are still lacking. The anxiolytic and anti-inflammatory effects of ruscogenin (RUS), an important active compound in Ophiopogon japonicus, were evaluated in a mouse model of chronic inflammatory pain and N9 cells. RUS (5, 10, or 20 mg/kg/day, i.g.) was administered once daily for 7 days after CFA injection; pain- and anxiety-like behaviors were assessed in mice. Anti-inflammatory effect of RUS (0.1, 1, 10 muM) on N9 microglia after LPS treatment was evaluated. Inflammatory markers (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, CD86, IL-4, ARG-1, and CD206) were measured using qPCR. The levels of IBA1, ROS, NF-kappaB, TLR4, P-IKK, P-IkappaBalpha, and P65, MAPKs (ERK, JNK, and P38), NLRP3 (caspase-1, ASC, and NLRP3) were detected by Western blotting or immunofluorescence staining. The potential target of RUS was validated by molecular docking and adeno-associated virus injection. Mice in CFA group exhibited allodynia and anxiety-like behaviors. LPS induced neuroinflammation in N9 cells. Both CFA and LPS increased the levels of IBA1, ROS, and inflammatory markers. RUS (10 mg/kg in vivo and 1 muM in vitro) alleviated these alterations through NF-kappaB/MAPKs/NLRP3 signaling pathways but had no effect on pain hypersensitivity. TLR4 strongly interacted with RUS, and TLR4 overexpression abolished the effects of RUS on anxiety and neuroinflammation. RUS exerts anti-inflammatory and anxiolytic effects via TLR4-mediated NF-kappaB/MAPKs/NLRP3 signaling pathways, which provides a basis for the treatment of chronic pain-induced anxiety.
abstract_zh: 长期炎症可通过敏化中枢神经系统引发慢性疼痛，并诱发患者的焦虑情绪。然而，目前仍缺乏副作用小且能有效治疗慢性疼痛诱发焦虑的药物。本研究在慢性炎症性疼痛小鼠模型和N9细胞中，评估了麦冬重要活性化合物鲁斯可皂苷元（RUS）的抗焦虑和抗炎作用。在CFA注射后，每日一次给予RUS（5、10或20 mg/kg/天，灌胃）连续7天；随后评估小鼠的疼痛和焦虑样行为。在LPS处理后，评估RUS（0.1、1、10 μM）对N9小胶质细胞的抗炎作用。使用qPCR检测炎症标志物（TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6、CD86、IL-4、ARG-1和CD206）。通过Western blotting或免疫荧光染色检测IBA1、ROS、NF-κB、TLR4、P-IKK、P-IκBα、P65、MAPKs（ERK、JNK和P38）、NLRP3（caspase-1、ASC和NLRP3）的水平。通过分子对接和腺相关病毒注射验证RUS的潜在靶点。CFA组小鼠表现出痛觉过敏和焦虑样行为。LPS诱导N9细胞产生神经炎症。CFA和LPS均增加了IBA1、ROS和炎症标志物的水平。RUS（体内10 mg/kg和体外1 μM）通过NF-κB/MAPKs/NLRP3信号通路缓解了这些变化，但对疼痛超敏无影响。TLR4与RUS强烈相互作用，且TLR4过表达消除了RUS对焦虑和神经炎症的作用。RUS通过TLR4介导的NF-κB/MAPKs/NLRP3信号通路发挥抗炎和抗焦虑作用，这为治疗慢性疼痛诱发的焦虑提供了基础。
